title: Oologah Work Barge Motors
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTHWESTERN.ENDIST TULSA.W076 ENDIST TULSA
description_text: The Tulsa Corp of Engineers is issuing a solicitation for outboard motors under W912BV26QA061.This specification is for the purchase and installation of two new 115 4-strokeoutboard motors, Twin engine control box, throttle and shift cables, stainless steel props, main engine harness, key switch, analog tachometer(s)/speedometer/hour meter(s)/voltage gauge(s)/fuel gauge/trim gauge(s), fuel/water separator assembly(s), trim and oil harness, and a hydraulic steering system for a Monark 24?Work Barge for the Oologah Lake Project Office in Rogers County, Oklahoma.
